title: Under The Water
tagline: A web-based educational game that raises climate change awareness by enabling players to retire on-chain carbon credits through engaging and simple gameplay mechanics.
description:
In this project, we use Polygon, Base, Push Protocol, Celo, Sign Protocol, Nouns, and Blockscout. After implementing these technologies, we tried to integrate with a carbon offset project from Toucan. We've found that many Web3 developers and even Web2 users aren't very aware of climate change and carbon offset projects in blockchain. We tried to provide some ideas and gamified actionable steps for their daily lives with simple features. 

Especially, we started this project because Thailand, where we are located, is one of the most vulnerable countries to climate change by geography, economy, and level of development. We want everyone in the web3 community to be aware and take action, even small steps, to help the society.

how_its_made:
We are integrating Tucan onchain carbon credit tokens in our minipay game. It support all 3 chains Tucan is using which include polygon, base and celo. Stable coin like USDC is used for easy exchange.  Push notification is also used to remind web3 friends to pay attention to global warming.
